summary: CKGSB's marketing team is prioritizing Asia Start and Intelligent China promotions while finalizing the knowledge website redesign, but must first resolve an Outlook lockout and meet immediate deadlines for the ESG report, Women in Leadership Forum, and Cartier roundtable.
summaryDetail: The team is focusing on China-based programs—Asia Start and Intelligent China—as the top promotion priority, with the Berkeley program as a possible third, while US partnerships with Stanford and Columbia are on hold for the first quarter. The knowledge website redesign is nearing completion: the team has combined elements from two design concepts, centered the menu, integrated BCI/BSI indices, and embedded videos into topics; Joseph must share the HTML file and schedule a feedback session. This week, urgent items include Ira combining comments on the ESG report for a final draft, Kaylee and Xuan reviewing Ira's emcee script for the Women in Leadership Forum, and DONG Kunyu coordinating logistics for the Nov 27 Cartier Women's Initiative roundtable. Also pending are the 2027 SEO/GEO/SEM and third-party costs proposal discussion early next week, Joseph's document on target audiences for search visibility, and the team's analysis of participant profiles and CRM leads to identify key geographic regions. The team also needs to resolve an Outlook account lockout by re-logging in and updating passwords on all devices, and has archived 9,618 unsubscribed entries while verifying 34,957 subscribed entries as part of the 2027 email platform review.
